predictions.source_summary: The function validates property names for objects used in math expression parsing and evaluation. The 'object' parameter is typically a plain object (scope, math namespace, or object node properties) that may contain user-defined or built-in properties. The 'prop' parameter is a string property name that may come from parsed expression syntax (e.g., object property access like 'obj.constructor').
predictions.sink_summary: The validation result (true/false) controls whether property access is allowed in getSafeProperty/setSafeProperty and object node compilation. If unsafe, an error is thrown preventing access to dangerous inherited properties like constructor, toString, call, apply, or ghosted properties.
predictions.guard_summary: The function implements multiple security checks: 1) Rejects non-objects; 2) Rejects 'ghosted' properties (own property that also exists in prototype); 3) Allows whitelisted native properties (e.g., 'length'); 4) Rejects properties inherited from Object.prototype; 5) Rejects properties inherited from Function.prototype. These controls aim to prevent prototype pollution and access to dangerous inherited methods.
predictions.risk_pattern: Property access validation that prevents access to inherited prototype properties which could lead to prototype pollution, property hijacking, or unintended method invocation when user-controlled property names reach object property access operations.

prop parameter (property name from parsed expression)

The changed function signature now accepts an object parameter, enabling enhanced prototype pollution protection by checking ghosted properties and prototype inheritance relative to the specific object.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.
